title: lint: os lint stays blind to a flow region the engine refuses to register; validate and build refuse it since #28893 through a CLI-only gate
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28893 dev (os-dev-report 6570600658), split off by this seat's placement ruling (A) and filed for `domain:devx`. Graded by this seat: p3. `validate` and `build` already refuse it, so only `os lint` and any lint-rule consumer miss it. Graded under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: an author running `os lint` (or a tool built on the authoring-rules registry) on a flow whose `loop` / `parallel` / `try_catch` region is not single-entry/single-exit, or whose `parallel` has one branch.
Reader who acts: the `domain:devx` seat (`packages/lint`).

## What happens

PR #29043 (#28893) adds `packages/cli/src/utils/flow-region-shape.ts`. It runs `FlowSchema` and then the spec's `validateControlFlow` for `os validate` and `os build`, the way #28727's `findExtensionFieldSuffixRefusals` does. The authoring-rules registry (`runAuthoringRules`, shared by validate, build and lint) does not carry it, so `os lint` still passes such a flow. `cli/test/authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts` records this as a `blindTo` row in its `OUTSIDE_THE_TABLE` table.

## Wanted

- An authoring rule in `packages/lint` that calls the spec's `validateControlFlow` (⛔ no copy), with the engine's message, so all three commands see it.
- Then retire the CLI-only gate, or keep it as a delegate, and move the parity row into `CASES`.
- One test per command.

Blocked-by: #28893 (PR #29043).

Dedupe: searched `lint flow region single-exit`; none. **New.**

Links back: #28893, PR #29043, #28727.
